meta.title: Deleting one activity of a service deletes all of that service's activities
gaps: Service-grouped events with services S1 and S2 cannot be created by the available setup recipes.
Deleting activity a and verifying that sibling activities b and c are also deleted cannot be expressed.
Forms and their deleted status cannot be read or verified.
The second deletion of activity d cannot be performed in the same service-grouped scenario.
The available line-item read-back only verifies a successful response, not which lines were deleted or retained.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, list the event's line items and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
